# Stick Picks

> Stick Picks is a hobby and lifestyle iOS app for adult cigar collectors.
> It catalogs your humidor, scans cigar bands to identify what you own,
> tracks the value of your collection, and provides a private journal for
> every cigar in your collection. The app does not sell tobacco, show
> tobacco ads, or promote tobacco use. It is a reference and personal-
> collection tool for adults aged 21 and over.

## Site
- [Home](https://stickpicks.app/): app overview, features, FAQ
- [About](https://stickpicks.app/about): who runs Stick Picks, editorial standards, what the app is and is not
- [Articles](https://stickpicks.app/articles): guides for cigar collectors (humidor care, valuation, identification, storage)
- [Support](https://stickpicks.app/support): account deletion, subscription cancellation, scanner tips
- [Privacy Policy](https://stickpicks.app/privacy): data collection and handling
- [Terms of Service](https://stickpicks.app/terms): eligibility, subscriptions, health notice
- [Delete Account](https://stickpicks.app/delete-account): how to permanently delete your account and data

## Optional
- [Sitemap](https://stickpicks.app/sitemap-index.xml): full URL index updated on every build
